entities.summary: Miguel Lahera Betancourt is a Cuban baseball player who is currently a free agent. He was part of the Cuba national baseball team that brought home a silver medal from the 2008 Summer Olympics, and also competed for the Cuba national baseball team in the 2008 Haarlem Baseball Week, 2009 World Port Tournament, 2009 World Baseball Classic, 2011 Pan American Games and 2017 World Baseball Classic.
